description: Send the app's pending changes to Google Play review — the API behind Play Console's "Send app for review". OUTWARD-FACING AND NOT FREELY REVERSIBLE: for an app that has never shipped this is the submission that decides whether it can be published at all. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT — it reports what would be sent and sends nothing until commit="true". Confirm with the user first, exactly like start_rollout. It fetches the publishing page's continuation token itself and round-trips it, which is what Play actually requires; the dry run also reports Play's own `blocked` flag, the best machine-readable "can this be sent?" in this capture. A FAILED_PRECONDITION here is NOT reliably a setup-task problem — that was wrong for a whole session. Read the dry run's `publishing_page` block and Play Console's Publishing overview before blaming the app's state.

commit.description: "true" actually submits. Omit or "false" for a dry run. Never pass "true" without the user's explicit agreement in this conversation.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email that owns this Play Console developer account. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

include_sections.description: Comma-separated non-track sections to include: store_listing, store_settings, app_content, preregistration, advanced_distribution. Mirrors the Publishing overview's own groups - include each group that shows pending changes.

include_track_ids.description: Comma-separated numeric track ids whose pending changes this submission covers (AppChangesToInclude.trackIds). Play Console always sends this selection; with neither this nor a section list the server has an empty selection and answers FAILED_PRECONDITION. To submit everything pending, pass every track that has pending changes on the Publishing overview.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

number_of_changes.description: The number of pending changes being submitted, exactly as Play Console's own "Submit N changes for review" button reads it. REQUIRED IN PRACTICE: Play treats this as a confirmation count and answers FAILED_PRECONDITION when it is missing, even when the Console's own button is enabled on the same pending set. Read N from the Publishing overview; do not guess.

play_app_id.description: Numeric Play app id from the Play Console URL (.../app/<this>/...). NOT the package name.

publishing_behaviour.description: "automatic" (default — changes go live as soon as review passes) or "manual" (hold for a manual go-live). Confirm which the user wants.

send_session_headers.description: Diagnostic only. "true" also sends the Console's own X-Play-Console-Session-Id and Accept-Language headers. Measured 2026-10-28: these are NOT required - the submission succeeds without them. Leave unset unless a write is refused for a reason the payload cannot explain.

name: send_app_for_review
